# WinIo64.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png)  ![:inline](/images/elmo.gif) 

### Description

WinIo64 is a hardware-access driver based on the WinIo library that provides direct physical-memory mapping and I/O-port operations from user mode. Its IOCTL interface exposes physical-memory map and unmap, I/O-port read and write, and physical-address translation primitives that are repeatedly incorporated into BYOVD tooling.
- **UUID**: 96501e5b-e4f2-41a9-a8ee-d09e36d31a39
- **Created**: 2026-04-22
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: Will Dormann, fluffycats31 | [@wdormann, @fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@wdormann, @fluffycats31)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create WinIo64 binPath=C:\windows\temp\WinIo64.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start WinIo64
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
